title: ToolCallResult
description: What a tool returned, wrapped so the model receives it as data. `content` is never concatenated into an instruction position: it holds text this platform did not write -- a mail server's greeting, an HTTP header, a host name from a certificate log -- and any of it may be an attempt to issue instructions. `untrusted` is always true for that reason and cannot be set false.

untrusted.description: Structural, not advisory. There is no shape of this document in which tool output is trusted input.

evidence_ids.description: What this result is drawn from, so a later claim citing it can be checked.
